name: Twin Lens
description: a small wiry hell imp of the Ember Wastes: crimson leathery skin, short curled black horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, larger than other imps, holding a glowing red lens shard in each clawed hand, one held high and one low, both eyes squinting through monocle-like glass

poses.stand: hovering on spread bat wings, a red lens shard held out in each hand, one high, one low
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: hovers, turning both red lens shards and squinting through them

attack.action: raises the upper red lens so it flares with a red beam to the right, then the lower lens flares with a second beam, then it lowers both

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
